text:
leah: Dropping the Sycamore RFI draft + capability matrix. Need SE / ProdSec / Legal thumbs before we send to procurement tomorrow AM. Attached: sycamore_rfi_v1.pdf, sycamore_capmatrix.csv

michael: quick read. Buyer wants a 7-day POC and expects ~450 concurrent embed calls during daily peak windows. Do we recommend Hosted burst or Dedicated eval for cost + SLA?

reza: I'd recommend Hosted with reserved burst for the week — faster onboarding. Put Dedicated option in the matrix if they require contractual uptime/tenant isolation.

anna: Security pass: missing KMS/HSM detail, data residency statement, log retention duration, and SOC2 link. Please fill Q20-Q27 in the questionnaire. Also confirm whether any raw data will be staged in our account during ingest.

leah: we'll state collector writes to customer-owned S3; we do not stage raw PII in Redwood accounts. I'll update the RFI language.

legal: I'll review liability and DPA. Two asks: 1) include DPA link in the RFI, 2) tighten POC liability cap to direct damages except gross negligence. Will upload redlines by 16:00 PT.

prodsec: ProdSec note: if they require HSM-backed keys in their cloud account, Private supports customer-managed HSM but adds ~3 weeks to timeline. Also request explicit EU residency phrasing if buyer is EU-based.

files-bot: Uploaded sycamore_rfi_v1.pdf (1.7MB), sycamore_capmatrix.csv (34KB), sycamore_security_qs.xlsx (28KB)

michael: uploaded sycamore_poc_costs.csv with conservative and optimistic forecasts; added an embeddings buffer of +20% for retries/spikes. Also noted quota bump lead time (48-72 hours).

reza: SE note  proposing a simple perf harness and synthetic dataset. POC plan: 2d setup/verify, 5d steady, 0d tail (7 days total). I'll attach benchmark_plan.md. Quick smoke-test curl for infra folks:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/embed \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $POC_KEY" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1b","input":"clinical note smoke test"}'
```

anna: noted re: HSM timeline. Also add a clear statement about log retention for the POC (30 days by default) and SOC2 link. I'll update the security sheet.

leah: timeline: incorporate small edits, get SE/ProdSec/Legal signoff, send to buyer by 09:00 UTC tomorrow. Ping here when done. :thumbsup:

reza: SE signoff done (bench plan + harness validated). Uploaded benchmark_plan.md.

prodsec: ProdSec signoff done after KMS wording tweak and explicit EU residency clause added.

legal: Uploaded sycamore_legal_redlines.docx with DPA link and liability tightening.

michael: confirmed all docs updated and costs merged. Ready to send when Leah gives go-ahead.

leah: Thanks team  sending to Sycamore procurement now and cc'ing ops. Great work. :rocket:
